description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Xml' with static methods for generating, manipulating, and validating XML and HTML-like markup. It includes functions for creating various XML/HTML elements, escaping content for JavaScript, and validating XML well-formedness. The file also defines a helper class 'XmlSelect' for managing select options.

classes.name: Xml
classes.description: Provides static utility functions for creating and validating XML/HTML elements, escaping content, and converting data to JavaScript.

classes.name: XmlSelect
classes.description: A helper class for generating HTML select elements with options, managing default selections and attributes.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Creates an XML or HTML element with specified attributes and content, escaping special characters except illegal XML characters.

methods.name: expandAttributes
methods.description: Generates a string of HTML attributes from an associative array, escaping attribute values with Sanitizer.

methods.name: elementClean
methods.description: Creates an element with content processed through UtfNormal::cleanUp to ensure valid UTF-8.

methods.name: openElement
methods.description: Creates an opening tag with optional attributes.

methods.name: closeElement
methods.description: Creates a closing tag.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Creates an element that contains provided content without escaping it.

methods.name: span
methods.description: Creates a span element with specified class and text.

methods.name: wrapClass
methods.description: Wraps content in a specified element with a class attribute.

methods.name: input
methods.description: Generates an HTML input element with attributes.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Generates a password input element.

methods.name: attrib
methods.description: Helper for HTML attributes, especially for checkboxes and radio buttons.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Creates a checkbox input element.

methods.name: radio
methods.description: Creates a radio button input element.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Creates a label element for a form control.

methods.name: inputLabel
methods.description: Creates a label and input element together.

methods.name: inputLabelSep
methods.description: Returns label and input as separate items.

methods.name: checkLabel
methods.description: Creates a checkbox with label.

methods.name: radioLabel
methods.description: Creates a radio button with label.

methods.name: submitButton
methods.description: Creates a submit button.

methods.name: hidden
methods.description: Creates a hidden input element.

methods.name: option
methods.description: Creates an option element for select menus.

methods.name: listDropDown
methods.description: Builds a select element from a newline-separated list, possibly with groups.

methods.name: fieldset
methods.description: Creates a fieldset element, optionally with a legend.

methods.name: textarea
methods.description: Creates a textarea element with specified content and attributes.

methods.name: escapeJsString
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in JavaScript source code.

methods.name: encodeJsVar
methods.description: Converts a PHP variable into its JavaScript literal representation.

methods.name: isWellFormed
methods.description: Checks if a string is well-formed XML.

methods.name: isWellFormedXmlFragment
methods.description: Checks if a string is well-formed XML fragment wrapped in HTML.

methods.name: escapeTagsOnly
methods.description: Replaces special characters in a string with HTML entities, escaping only tags and quotes.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds an HTML form table structure from fields and optional submit button.
